overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics clearly highlights 'What If' hypothetical space scenarios and exotic planetary phenomena published within the last 7 days as the dominant growth drivers for FACTVERSE. Videos utilizing 'What If You Fell Into...' structures (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y, 8KEl0_pJ_68, YlDuGu1vzAg, 6pwazIPnOHw) demonstrate superior views-per-day velocity and higher like-to-view ratios compared to standard static fact declarations or older psychology/animal shorts. Audience engagement heavily favors immersive, second-person hypothetical space travel combined with extreme physical or chemical anomalies.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) achieved over 970 to 1,024 views rapidly within days of release with strong engagement (up to 38 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on 'What If' survival and exploration scenarios set in extreme extraterrestrial environments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Bizarre planetary weather and material extremes
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring high-value or extreme substances (Rubies, Diamond, Burning Ice, Molten Iron) such as QXuqYERlqSo and vWd0uYcEGh4 generate high view velocity.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing hooks on mind-bending physical states or extreme weather on newly discovered or theoretical celestial bodies.

weak_patterns.pattern: Static psychological tricks and general brain facts
weak_patterns.evidence: Older or less recent uploads regarding brain memories and psychological habits (e.g., ef3ND4qiRHc, 5AN7LUgqarc, 2fqaGqfsR4A) stalled below 75 views with minimal interaction.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological trivia unless tied to a high-stakes narrative or mystery micro-story.

weak_patterns.pattern: Dry historical or foundational science facts without narrative tension
weak_patterns.evidence: General science statements like 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' or basic animal fact declarations underperformed relative to the dynamic hypothetical space content.
weak_patterns.action: Inject immediate narrative peril or counter-intuitive paradoxes into any foundational science topic if selected.
